summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all six paragraphs of the selected working Greek. Both preserve the dialogue, virtue list, commands, repentance and remaining-days clause, compulsory persuasion, conditional assertions, and salvation warning extending to children and household. The simplified edition does not materially weaken or supplement these assertions. Servant/serve and repentance/repent follow current contextual policy. The notes accurately disclose the supplied bounded reports, including the differing Latin list and the Vulgata-derived supply within the Palatina manuscript gap, without replacing the working Greek or claiming fresh manuscript verification. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and evidence, not authentication of unseen editions or exhaustive collation.
